component.name: Core Rules
component.summary: Browse and edit AD&D Core Rules 2.0 characters and rules

description.p: A modern replica of AD&D Core Rules 2.0, the 1998 Windows character manager for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd Edition. It reads and writes the data files of the original program, so characters made in either program open in the other.
The app contains no rules content. It opens a Core Rules 2.0 (or Expansion) installation you already own, or its CD, and shows:

ul.li: Characters, with editing of abilities, proficiencies, languages, spells, equipment and money
Races, classes, items, spells and psionic powers

screenshot.caption: A character made in the original program

description.p: Characters can now gain experience, and their sheet can be printed.

ul.li: Add experience and level up, with hit point rolls, Skills & Powers points and racial level limits
Spell slots per spell level when memorizing spells
Character sheet: view, print, save as PDF and export HTML or text

description.p: Characters can now be created and fully edited.

ul.li: New Character wizard with Core Rules and Player's Option (Skills & Powers) creation
Edit proficiencies, languages, spells known, spellbooks and memorized spells
Edit every equipment group with quantities, and spending money
Humans can add a class (dual-class) under the Player's Handbook rules

description.p: New app icon: a burgundy tome with the dragon ampersand.

ul.li: Opens Core Rules 2.0 and Expansion installations, or their CD
Browses characters, races, classes, items, spells, psionics and monsters
Edits characters and saves files the original programs open
